text:
Predicates:
Striker(x) ::: x is a striker.
SoccerPlayer(x) ::: x is a soccer player.
LeftTeam(x, y) ::: x left team y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for team y.
Team(y) ::: y is a team.
Star(x) ::: x is a star.
Premises:
Striker(x) → SoccerPlayer(x) ::: Strikers are soccer players.
LeftTeam(robert, bayernMunich) ::: Robert Lewandowski left Bayern Munich.
LeftTeam(x, y) → ¬PlaysFor(x, y) ::: If a player left a team, they no longer play for that team.
Conclusion:
Star(robert) ::: Robert Lewandowski is a star.
